steps.what: Produce computer readable digital images from film
Scan using flatbed scanners and photofinishing laboratories

tasks.design: The photographer produces computer-readable digital images from film, using flatbed scanners and photofinishing laboratories. Operating the scanner and sending the film stay at full effort. Nothing in {DOCS} runs the scanner.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer runs the scanner or sends the film.
tasks.enabler_now: No unattended step replaces the photographer at the scanner.
tasks.still_hard: Producing the digital image stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the scan is not of the film they meant.
tasks.altitude: The scan stays at full effort.

reach.task: Scan only the film the photographer sends
reach.learn: Which scans were of the wrong film.

evidence.claim: Producing digital images from film on a scanner or at a laboratory stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with film and ends when the photographer has a digital image, or stops.
No new record is required beyond the file. Upkeep is zero.
Retouching the scan is a different task.
unknowns: Which film is scanned in house, and which goes to a laboratory.
research_questions: How often was the scan of the wrong film?

already_counted.description: Producing the digital images is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the scan adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every scan is still done by the photographer or sent by them. High: the same scan remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Employ specialized photographic materials and techniques
Use infrared and ultraviolet films, including macro photography
Use photogrammetry and sensitometry for a variety of materials

tasks.design: The photographer employs specialized photographic materials and techniques, including infrared and ultraviolet films, macro photography, photogrammetry, and sensitometry. The work stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} chooses the technique.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer chooses and uses the technique.
tasks.still_hard: The technique stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer rejects a material the subject does not support.
tasks.altitude: The specialised work stays at full effort.

reach.task: Say which technique the job needs

evidence.claim: Using these specialised photographic materials and techniques stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a subject and ends when the photographer has used the technique, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A caption for the frame is a different task.
unknowns: Which jobs need infrared or ultraviolet, and which need macro.
research_questions: Which materials did the photographer reject?

already_counted.description: Choosing the materials and techniques is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the technique adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every technique is still used by the photographer. High: the same specialised work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Decide whether to license the use of photographs
Set terms through the stock photo agencies
Review the licence before it is sent
Send the accepted licence to the agency

tasks.design: The photographer licenses the use of photographs through stock photo agencies. The decision and the terms stay at full effort. {EMAIL} sends only the licence the photographer has accepted. A blank term stays blank and stops the send. The send does not grant a use the photographer did not write.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer decided the terms and sent them.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted licence can be sent. Choosing the terms stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Whether to license, and on what terms, stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer refuses a use the photograph does not support.
tasks.altitude: The licence is sent only after the photographer accepts that version.

reach.task: Receive only a licence the photographer accepted

evidence.claim: An accepted licence text can be sent. Choosing the terms stays manual.
A portrait made without commission may not be published if the person has a reasonable interest against it. The photographer still decides whether to license.

assumptions: The work starts with a request and ends when the accepted licence is sent, or the photographer stops.
A licence draft has photograph identifier, use, and term, written by the photographer. A blank term is left blank and is not invented.
The send uses the licence accepted in the review. It does not choose the use.
unknowns: Which uses the photographer will not license.
research_questions: How often did a blank term stop the send?

already_counted.description: Deciding whether to license is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a term before the licence is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: terms are often blank, so the photographer still decides the licence. High: terms are complete, the photographer reviews them, and only the accepted licence is sent. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop and print exposed film using chemicals
Use touch tools and developing and printing equipment

tasks.design: The photographer develops and prints exposed film, using chemicals, touch-up tools, and developing and printing equipment. The darkroom work stays at full effort, including the touch-up. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} develops the film.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer develops, prints, and touches up the film.
tasks.still_hard: Developing, printing, and the touch-up stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the chemical is not the one the film needs.
tasks.altitude: The darkroom work stays at full effort. The touch-up is not cut.

reach.task: Set out the chemical the photographer names

evidence.claim: Developing and printing film, including touch-up, stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with exposed film and ends when the photographer has printed it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Scanning the print is a different task.
research_questions: Which prints did the photographer reject?

already_counted.description: Developing and printing the film is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the darkroom adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every film is still developed by the photographer. High: the same darkroom work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
